answers.title: Course ka career map
answers.detail: Is course ke baad log kaun se roles mein jaate hain, ye saath baith ke dekho. Seedha ghar walon ko dikhao.

answers.title: Seniors ki kahani
answers.detail: Jo is course ko kar chuke hain, unse baat karo. Mummy Papa ko bhi call pe saath bithao.

answers.title: Plan B bhi ready
answers.detail: Pehla plan na chale toh kya karoge, ye bhi socho. Ghar walon ka bharosa isi se banta hai.

caption:
